summaries.R1-L1: Over-invoicing can move extra money to the seller disguised as payment for goods. The officer could ask the customer to explain the high price for these goods.
summaries.R7-INV: Goods sent to a residential address can be a way to obscure the true recipient of a large shipment. The officer could ask the customer to provide a business address for the consignee.
summaries.R2-L1: An implausible quantity-value relationship can indicate misrepresentation of the goods' true worth. The officer could ask the customer to clarify how the total value was calculated given the quantity.
